hero.title: Run your whole school from one place
hero.subtitle: Students, teachers, classes, attendance and grades in a single secure system — with the right access for every role.

features.title: Everything the academic office needs
features.subtitle: Built around the daily work of administrators, teachers and students.

users.title: Users and roles
users.text: Create admin, teacher and student accounts with temporary passwords, lockout protection and device sign-out.

academics.title: Academic structure
academics.text: Departments, programs, academic years, terms and a course catalog, set up in minutes.

timetable.title: Sections and timetable
timetable.text: Schedule classes with automatic clash checks for teachers, rooms and students, and seat limits.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.text: Teachers mark a whole class in seconds. Students are told when they are marked absent or late.

grades.title: Grades and GPA
grades.text: Enter scores, see letter grades instantly, and publish through a review workflow. GPA is calculated automatically.

reports.title: Reports and export
reports.text: Seats, attendance and results per section, students who need attention, and CSV export.

portals.title: One system, three tailored portals
portals.subtitle: Everyone sees exactly what they need — and nothing they shouldn't.

admin.title: Administrators
admin.item4: Reports and a full audit log

workflow.title: Grades are reviewed before students see them
workflow.subtitle: Every step is recorded, and scores are locked while they are under review.

step1.title: Draft
step1.text: The teacher enters and saves scores.

step2.title: Submitted
step2.text: Scores are locked and sent for review.

step3.title: Approved
step3.text: A reviewer approves, or sends them back with a note.

step4.title: Published
step4.text: Students see their grade and updated GPA.

security.title: Secure by design
security.subtitle: Access is checked on the server for every request, never only in the browser.

permissions.title: Action-based permissions
permissions.text: Each action is a permission with a scope: everything, assigned classes, or only your own records.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.text: Every sensitive change records who did it, when, and the values before and after.

accounts.title: Protected accounts
accounts.text: Hashed passwords, lockout after repeated failures, and sign-out of all devices.

api.title: API first
api.text: A REST API behind every screen, ready for a mobile app or other systems.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.subtitle: Log in with the account your administrator gave you.
